Privacy Policy

This policy explains what CasinoMY Insider collects when you visit this website, why we collect it, and what rights you have over it. By using the site you accept the practices described here. We handle personal data in line with Malaysia's Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA).

1. What we collect

We collect two kinds of information:

  • Technical data gathered automatically — browser type and version, device type, approximate location derived from IP address, referring source, and the pages you view. This is used in aggregate for analytics and traffic monitoring.
  • Information you choose to give us — your name, email address and message content when you contact us about a correction, question or partnership enquiry.

We do not collect or store payment card details, banking credentials, casino account passwords or any other financial data. We never ask for them, and no page on this site requests them. Any message claiming to be from us and asking for such details is not from us.

2. Why we use it

We use data only to reply to enquiries and corrections, to understand which pages are read so we know what to update, to keep the site working and secure, and to meet legal obligations. We do not build advertising profiles, and we do not sell, rent or trade personal information to anyone.

3. Cookies and analytics

The site uses cookies to remember display preferences and to measure traffic through Google Analytics, which records visits in aggregate. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings; some conveniences may stop working, but the content remains fully readable. We also embed a Trustpilot widget, which may set its own cookies under Trustpilot's policy.

4. Links to casino operators

This site links out to third-party online casinos. Once you follow one of those links you are on their platform and subject to their privacy policy and data practices, not ours. We have no control over and accept no responsibility for what they collect. Read their policies before registering or submitting identity documents to them.

5. Affiliate disclosure

Some outbound links are affiliate links, meaning we may receive a commission if you open an account through them. The operator may record that the referral came from us. Commission has no bearing on our ratings, rankings or whether a review is published — see our editorial guidelines for how scoring actually works.

6. Storage, retention and security

We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect the limited data we hold against loss, misuse and unauthorised access, and access is restricted to team members who need it. Correspondence is retained only as long as needed to handle the matter and keep a record of published corrections. No transmission over the internet can be guaranteed completely secure.

7. Your rights

Under the PDPA and other applicable law you may request access to the personal data we hold about you, ask for it to be corrected or deleted, withdraw consent where processing relies on it, limit how it is used, or complain to a data protection authority. Email info@casinomyinsider.com and we will respond within 30 days. We may ask you to confirm your identity before acting on a request.

8. Children

This site is intended for adults aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18. If you believe a minor has sent us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

9. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as the site or the law changes. Revisions are posted here with a new review date. Questions about anything above can go through our contact page.
